<script setup lang="ts" generic="Type extends 'text' | 'number' = 'text'">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { PinInputRoot, type PinInputRootEmits, type PinInputRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PinInputRootProps<Type>>(), {
  modelValue: () => [],
});
const emits = defineEmits<PinInputRootEmits<Type>>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <PinInputRoot
    data-slot="pin-input"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-pin-input"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </PinInputRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-pin-input {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<PrimitiveProps>();

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="pin-input-group"
    v-bind="{ ...forwardedProps, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-pin-input-group"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-pin-input-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { PinInputInput, type PinInputInputProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<PinInputInputProps>();

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <PinInputInput
    data-slot="pin-input-input"
    v-bind="{ ...forwardedProps, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-pin-input-input"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  />
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-pin-input-input {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  width: calc(var(--spacing) * 10);
  height: calc(var(--spacing) * 10);
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--input);
  border-left: none;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  text-align: center;
  transition: all 150ms;
}

.sigma-ui-pin-input-input:first-child {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--input);
  border-bottom-left-radius: 0.375rem;
  border-top-left-radius: 0.375rem;
}

.sigma-ui-pin-input-input:last-child {
  border-bottom-right-radius: 0.375rem;
  border-top-right-radius: 0.375rem;
}

.sigma-ui-pin-input-input:focus {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: -1px;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { DotIcon } from 'lucide-vue-next';

const props = defineProps<PrimitiveProps>();
const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="pin-input-separator"
    v-bind="forwardedProps"
    class="sigma-ui-pin-input-separator"
  >
    <slot>
      <DotIcon class="sigma-ui-pin-input-separator__icon" />
    </slot>
  </Primitive>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-pin-input-separator {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.sigma-ui-pin-input-separator__icon {
  width: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
  height: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
</style>
